**Goal**: regenerate `datasets/sitemap.xml` — the file [ODISCat record 3318](https://catalogue.odis.org/view/3318) points at — from the release's own dataset record, so what a crawler is told matches what CalCOFI publishes.

Until 2026-09-05 this notebook read a hand-maintained [Google Sheet of repositories](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1uhviF2ecfOqGaSbC_JE8B5jPRqqjMaFc9TNCK_m297c/edit?gid=1271784325) (snapshot 2025-07-02), asked ERDDAP and EDI what they held, and listed **78 external pages** with `lastmod` = the run date. Every one of those pages belonged to somebody else, none of them was a CalCOFI record, and a package that had been superseded stayed on the list forever.

Since the dataset-catalog plan (2026-09-05 § D-10, Decision 15) the sitemap is a **generated view of `datasets.json`**:

1.  **The calcofi.io dataset pages come first** — `https://calcofi.io/datasets/{dataset_key}/`, one per public dataset and per public holding. They are the canonical records: each carries schema.org JSON-LD naming every external copy as `sameAs`, so a crawler meeting the same dataset twice can tell it is one dataset.
2.  **Then every `current` / `external` record at another portal** — the EDI package at its newest revision, the OBIS dataset and its IPT resource, the NCEI accession, the CoastWatch mirrors, the DataZoo catalog pages, the CalOOS modules, the ERDDAP dataset pages on calcofi.io and at NOAA.
3.  **Never a `superseded` or `retired` one.** Those rows stay in `metadata/distribution.csv` — nothing is ever deleted from the registry, so a dataset page can say *"was at X until 2026-08; now at Y"* — and they are simply not listed. Pointing a crawler at a legacy ERDDAP id is how a retired copy outlives its successor.

`lastmod` is measured, not stamped with the run date: a page's is the later of the release date and its descriptive sidecar's last edit; an external record's is what the portal itself said when `observe_distributions()` last asked (`metadata/distribution_observed.json`).

The logic lives in `calcofi4db` (`build_datasets_sitemap()`, `write_sitemap_xml()`, `check_sitemap()`) and has its own tests, so this notebook and the weekly GitHub Action cannot drift from each other — both call the same functions through `scripts/build_datasets_sitemap.R`.

## What each portal says now

`observe_distributions()` (calcofi4db ≥ 4.3.0) asks each portal by the method its `metadata/portal.csv` row declares — EDI's cite service for the newest revision, `api.obis.org` for `updated`, an ERDDAP `.das` for `date_modified`, `doi.org`, NCBI's esummary, Zenodo's API, a ranged GET for everything else — over the curated registry **and** the holdings' own links. `.github/workflows/observe.yml` runs it weekly and commits the result.

```{r}
#| label: observed

librarian::shelf(
  calcofi/calcofi4db, dplyr, DT, glue, here, jsonlite, readr, quiet = TRUE)
options(readr.show_col_types = FALSE)

dir_meta <- here("metadata")
registry <- read_distribution_registry(file.path(dir_meta, "distribution.csv"))
observed <- read_distribution_observed(file.path(dir_meta, "distribution_observed.json"))

if (is.null(observed)) {
  cat("no distribution_observed.json yet — run `Rscript scripts/observe_distributions.R`\n")
} else {
  cat(glue(
    "{nrow(observed)} distributions observed at {observed$observed_utc[1]} ",
    "({nrow(registry)} curated registry rows + the holdings' links)\n"))
  observed |>
    mutate(url = glue("<a href='{url}' target='_blank'>{url}</a>")) |>
    select(dataset_key, portal, method, status, registry_status, revision, updated, url, note) |>
    datatable(escape = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 15))
}
```

A change since the last observation is a **proposal, never a silent edit**: a new EDI revision, a DOI newly minted, a dead link becomes a `proposed` `questions.csv` row (`observed_change`) for the dataset's provider, and the same line appears in the `calcofi` Sheet's `holdings` tab.

```{r}
#| label: changes

if (!is.null(observed)) {
  j <- fromJSON(file.path(dir_meta, "distribution_observed.json"), simplifyVector = FALSE)
  ch <- j$changes
  if (!length(ch)) {
    cat("no change since the previous observation\n")
  } else {
    bind_rows(lapply(ch, as_tibble)) |>
      datatable(caption = "changes since the last observation (each one a proposed provider question)")
  }
  # what the portals say beyond liveness
  observed |>
    count(status, method) |>
    datatable(options = list(dom = "t", pageLength = 20), caption = "observation status by method")
}
```

## Write `datasets/sitemap.xml`

```{r}
#| label: sitemap

version  <- Sys.getenv("CALCOFI_SITEMAP_VERSION", "")
prefix   <- Sys.getenv("CALCOFI_RELEASE_PREFIX", "ducklake/releases")
base     <- glue("https://storage.googleapis.com/calcofi-db/{prefix}")
if (!nzchar(version))
  version <- trimws(readLines(glue("{base}/latest.txt"), warn = FALSE))[1]

record   <- fromJSON(glue("{base}/{version}/datasets.json"), simplifyVector = FALSE)
sidecars <- read_dataset_sidecars(dir_meta)
edited   <- vapply(names(sidecars), function(k) {
  y <- sidecars[[k]]
  e <- as.character(y[["edited"]] %||% "")[1]
  if (!is.na(e) && nzchar(e)) return(substr(e, 1, 10))
  g <- suppressWarnings(system2("git", c("-C", here(), "log", "-1", "--format=%cs", "--", y[["path"]]),
                                stdout = TRUE, stderr = FALSE))
  if (length(g) && nzchar(g[1])) g[1] else ""
}, "")

d <- build_datasets_sitemap(record, observed = observed, edited = edited)
write_sitemap_xml(d, here("datasets/sitemap.xml"))

n_pages <- sum(d$kind == "page" & d$portal == "calcofi.io")
cat(glue("{nrow(d)} URLs — {n_pages} calcofi.io dataset pages then ",
         "{nrow(d) - n_pages} external records (release {version})\n"))

d |>
  mutate(loc = glue("<a href='{loc}' target='_blank'>{loc}</a>")) |>
  datatable(escape = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 20))
```

```{r}
#| label: sitemap_check

# the structural half always runs; the network half (a one-byte ranged GET per URL,
# ~100 s for 127 URLs) follows CALCOFI_SKIP_LINK_CHECK like every other link check.
# CALCOFI_PAGES_PENDING=1 forgives the calcofi.io dataset pages — and only those —
# while the landing repo has not generated them yet (plan Phase 1, WS-P1).
chk   <- check_sitemap(d)
allow <- if (nzchar(Sys.getenv("CALCOFI_PAGES_PENDING"))) "^https://calcofi[.]io/datasets/" else character()
assert_sitemap(chk, allow_dead = allow)

chk |>
  filter(finding != "ok") |>
  datatable(caption = "sitemap check findings (url_dead fails; url_unreachable is someone else's outage)")
```

```{r}
#| label: copy_to_output

# the sitemap is served from calcofi.io/workflows/datasets/sitemap.xml
dir_to <- here("_output")
dir.create(dir_to, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
file.copy(here("datasets"), dir_to, recursive = TRUE, overwrite = TRUE)
```

**Datasets** `sitemap.xml`:

-   [`calcofi.io/workflows/datasets/sitemap.xml`](https://calcofi.io/workflows/datasets/sitemap.xml)

## Regenerating it

```bash
# after a release (the record changed), or weekly (a portal revised a package)
Rscript scripts/observe_distributions.R      # -> metadata/distribution_observed.json
Rscript scripts/build_datasets_sitemap.R     # -> datasets/sitemap.xml
```

`.github/workflows/observe.yml` runs both on a weekly cron, on `workflow_dispatch` and on the release dispatch, and commits whatever changed. ODISCat record 3318 is re-pointed at this file by WS-M2 (with Ben).

## The ODIS record

Record [catalogue.odis.org/view/3318](https://catalogue.odis.org/view/3318) — [print](./datasets/CalCOFI%20on%20ODIS%20record%203318.pdf), [screenshot](./datasets/CalCOFI%20on%20ODIS%20record%203318.png) — is the entry ODIS crawls the sitemap through, per [book.odis.org/gettingStarted.html](https://book.odis.org/gettingStarted.html) and [iodepo/odis-arch#461](https://github.com/iodepo/odis-arch/issues/461#issuecomment-2429931617).

![](./datasets/CalCOFI%20on%20ODIS%20record%203318.png)

Its spatial coverage is the CalCOFI station-grid envelope, in schema.org's lat-long (Y X) order:

```{r}
#| label: odis_extent

librarian::shelf(calcofi/calcofi4r, sf, quiet = TRUE)

cc_ply <- calcofi4r::cc_grid_zones |>
  st_union() |>
  (\(x) st_multipolygon(lapply(x, function(p) p[1])))() |>
  st_sfc(crs = 4326) |>
  st_cast("POLYGON") |>
  st_simplify(preserveTopology = TRUE, dTolerance = 10 * 1000) |>   # 10 km
  st_as_sf() |>
  slice(1)

cc_txt <- cc_ply |>
  st_geometry() |>
  st_as_text(digits = 4) |>
  gsub("([-0-9.]+)\\s+([-0-9.]+)", "\\2 \\1", x = _) |>             # swap to Y X
  gsub(",\\s", ",", x = _) |>
  gsub("POLYGON \\(\\((.*)\\)\\)", "\\1", x = _)

cat(glue("{nchar(cc_txt)} characters\n"))
substr(cc_txt, 1, 300)
```

## What this replaced

The old repository Sheet, `datasets/repo_links.csv`, `datasets/repo_datasets.csv` and the JSON-LD scrape of 78 external pages are retired: `metadata/distribution.csv` (curated, reviewed, in git) and `metadata/holdings.csv` (generated from the sidecars) carry the same knowledge with a `status` per row, and `observe_distributions()` refreshes it weekly instead of a person re-reading a spreadsheet.
